reviews.author: Manuel São Bento
reviews.content:
FULL SPOILER-FREE REVIEW @ https://fandomwire.com/bad-apples-review/

"Bad Apples is a shocking, original satire, carried by Saoirse Ronan in a state of grace and surprising child performances.

Its journey toward the absurd is highly entertaining, but the constant collision between the dramatic weight of the staging and the ridiculousness of the script creates a tonal dissonance that affects its final message and its potential to be one of the most powerful films of the year.

It deserves to be seen, debated, and perhaps, to make us question what, after all, a "bad apple" in life truly is."

Rating: B

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A overwhelmed primary school teacher finds her life and moral compass unraveling after an accident involving one of her students pushes her toward increasingly reckless choices.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Struggling to manage the pressures of a chaotic primary school classroom and a demanding personal life, a dedicated teacher reaches her breaking point when a student is unexpected injured. Fearful of the professional fallout and personal scrutiny, she makes a series of questionable decisions to cover up the details of the incident. As her lies compound, the line between protecting her career and shielding her pupils blurs. Balancing dark comedy with psychological tension, the story highlights the fragile nature of an overworked educator pushed to the edge.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a poorly funded primary school, a well-meaning teacher finds herself drowning in administrative pressure, difficult parents, and an unruly classroom. Her precarious balance shatters when an accidental injury leaves one of her students hurt during her supervision. Panicking over the potential destruction of her career and reputation, she makes a split-second decision to conceal the exact circumstances of the accident. What starts as a minor cover-up quickly snowballs into a complex web of deceit as administrators, police, and suspicious parents begin asking targeted questions. To maintain the lie, she relies on increasingly unorthodox and questionable tactics, pulling coworkers and pupils into her orbit of chaos. As the investigation deepens, the internal pressure takes a toll on her sanity, driving her to act even more erratically. The narrative weaves sharp comedy through the absurdity of primary school bureaucracy while escalating the thriller elements of her pending exposure. Ultimately, her descent reveals the systemic strains on educators and the dangerous lengths one will go to avoid accountability when back into a corner.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set within the high-stress environment of a modern primary school, Bad Apples is a darkly comedic thriller about the precarious line between good intentions and bad judgment. When an unforeseen incident leaves a young student injured, a dedicated yet burnt-out teacher panics, choosing to obscure the truth rather than face immediate fallout. As school officials and parents seek answers, her desperate attempts to manage the narrative force her down a path of bizarre and risky choices, threatening to expose not just her secret, but the chaotic reality of the institution itself.
